title: Naval forces seize P398M in smuggled cigarettes off Sulu

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Naval forces intercepted nearly P398 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes and motorized crafts off the coast of Sulu in three separate operations in the past four days, officials reported Tuesday. The successive operations conducted by the Naval Command Western Mindanao (NCWM) from Oct. 29 to Nov. 1 led to the seizure of 2,581 master cases of illicit cigarettes and the motorized vessels used in transport, carrying a total estimated value of P397,805,257.60. The operations also resulted in the arrest of 18 crew members, who were subsequently turned over to the Bureau of Customs (BOC) […]...
